summary_paragraph: A woman with type 1 diabetes, gastroparesis, and anxiety was admitted for bright red blood per rectum and diarrhea. The bleeding was scant and self-limited, with no further episodes in hospital. Her hemoglobin remained stable, and no source was found on exam. Diarrhea and nausea resolved during the stay. She was managed with IV fluids, antiemetics, and adjustment of her metoclopramide dose. Blood glucose was labile but never reached DKA. Anxiety and chronic back pain were addressed with medications. She tolerated a regular diet by discharge, was ambulatory, and discharged home with updated prescriptions and follow-up plans.
